about: Reno-Sparks, NV research for Veterans Day 2026, compiled 11 Nov 2026 from a research report (10 Nov) and checked against each source. Items here are region-wide perks and events outside the route circles or on other days.

other.name: RTC Washoe: free rides for everyone
other.where: Every RTC service in Reno, Sparks and Washoe County: RTC RIDE buses, RTC ACCESS and RTC FlexRIDE
other.offer: No fare and no pass needed on any RTC service all day on 11 Nov, for every rider. ACCESS and FlexRIDE eligibility and booking rules still apply. RTC's offices are closed.
other.note: Downtown streets close 5 AM-3 PM for the parade, so the bus is the easy way in. Plan trips at rtcwashoe.com or in the Transit app.

other.name: Casino Fandango, Carson City: free buffet for veterans
other.where: 3800 S Carson St, Carson City, NV (about 30 miles south of Reno)
other.offer: A free buffet at Ti Amo Italian Grille for veterans and first responders who are CF Rewards members, with ID. Others pay $30.99 plus tax and tip.
other.note: Needs Casino Fandango's free CF Rewards membership (players' clubs generally need you to be 21, with a photo ID).

other.name: Virginia City Veterans Day Parade
other.where: C Street, Virginia City, NV (about 25 miles southeast of Reno)
other.offer: Veterans Day parade on C Street, on the official tourism calendar.

other.name: Fallon: free veterans breakfast and opening ceremonies
other.where: Fallon Convention Center, 100 Campus Way, Fallon, NV (about 60 miles east of Reno)
other.offer: A free breakfast for the first 300 veterans, opening with ceremonies; hosted by the Fallon Chamber of Commerce and New Millennium. Not advertised for guests.

other.name: Truckee: Eagle Plaza ceremony and veterans lunch
other.where: Eagle Plaza, Donner Pass Rd and Spring St, Truckee, CA (about 32 miles west on I-80); lunch at Veterans Hall, 10214 High St
other.offer: The Town of Truckee's outdoor ceremony at 11:00 (a veteran speaker, music, a student essay winner), then a free lunch for veterans and families at Veterans Hall, hosted by American Legion Post 439.
other.note: Outdoors at about 5,800 feet: dress for the weather, and check I-80 over the Sierra before you go.

other.name: South Lake Tahoe: American Legion Hall ceremony
other.where: American Legion Hall, 2748 Lake Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA (about 60 miles south)
other.offer: A Veterans Day ceremony with a county proclamation honoring veterans; the public is invited.

other.name: National parks: fee-free day for US residents
other.where: Every National Park Service site that charges entrance; the nearest are hours from Reno (Lassen Volcanic, Yosemite)
other.offer: Entrance fees are waived on Veterans Day for US citizens and residents (new for 2026: nonresidents pay). Camping, reservations and other fees still apply.
other.note: Veterans and Gold Star families also get a free lifetime Military Pass for federal recreation sites, good any day.

other.name: Nevada Museum of Art: free for everyone (Hands ON! Second Saturday)
other.offer: Free admission for all visitors, with hands-on art projects and quill-and-ink activities 10 AM-4 PM. On Veterans Day itself admission is free only for veterans and active duty.

leads.name: Peppermill Reno (Cafe Milano)
leads.q: Peppermill Reno Veterans Day Cafe Milano
leads.offer: In 2025: one free item from Cafe Milano's comfort menu for veterans, 9 AM-2 PM, with a military or VA ID. No 2026 offer found; the 2025 page is gone.

leads.name: Western Village (Primo)
leads.q: Western Village Sparks Veterans Day Primo pizza
leads.offer: In 2025: a free pizza slice and soda at Primo, 11 AM-1 PM (News 4's 2025 list). No 2026 offer found.

leads.name: Grand Sierra Resort
leads.offer: Its Veterans Day page still shows 2024 ("Monday, November 11"): 50% off the Grand Buffet, 35% off at the spa, a free hour of bowling, a free slot tournament entry. No 2026 lineup found.

leads.name: Nugget Casino Resort
leads.q: Nugget Casino Resort Sparks Veterans Day

leads.name: Eldorado, Silver Legacy and Circus Circus
leads.q: Eldorado Silver Legacy Circus Circus Reno Veterans Day
leads.offer: The only offer found was a free buffet in 2017. Nothing for 2026.

leads.name: Marked Studios: free veteran tattoos
leads.q: Marked Studios Reno Veterans Day tattoos
leads.offer: Its 13th annual Veterans Day event in 2025: free tattoos for veterans, active-duty and retired military with a DD-214 or military ID, doors 8 AM. No 2026 announcement found.

leads.name: Black Bear Diner (Reno and Sparks)
leads.q: Black Bear Diner Reno Sparks Veterans Day
leads.offer: Each diner sets its own Veterans Day policy; no 2026 offer found for these stores.

leads.name: Chick-fil-A (Reno and Sparks)
leads.offer: A free sandwich or 8-count nuggets at some Reno stores in 2025 (News 4's 2025 list). Owners choose; no 2026 word for these stores.

leads.name: Jiffy Lube (Northern Nevada)
leads.q: Jiffy Lube Reno Veterans Day free oil change
leads.offer: Participating Northern Nevada stores gave a free conventional oil change in 2025 (2 News, 8 Nov 2025). No 2026 word.

leads.name: AUSA Westmoreland Chapter Veterans Day dinner
leads.q: AUSA Westmoreland Chapter Veterans Day dinner 2026
leads.offer: Fri 13 Nov, ticketed; speaker retired Air Force Lt. Col. Tony Grady (This Is Reno; not checked).

leads.name: National Automobile Museum
leads.q: National Automobile Museum Reno military discount
leads.offer: No Veterans Day offer found; a standing military discount (sources differ on the price).
